attempts.surface: Unified task composer UI via Electron CDP + Playwright; round-owned fixture manifest

actual_preconditions.fixtures: 35 tiny round-owned TXT attachments; unsent draft

attempts.input: Selected 20 round-owned files, then selected 15 different round-owned files in a second operation.
actual_steps: Selected count-01.txt through count-20.txt in the in-app HTML file input and read back 20 cards.
Selected count-21.txt through count-35.txt in a second file-input operation.
Waited for all uploads to settle. The UI showed 35 cards and 35 per-file removal controls; all 15 new filenames were present.
Checked visible alert/status/toast controls: no limit warning or rejection feedback was present.
Removed all 35 round-owned attachments individually and confirmed zero cards remained.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited until all visible 上传中 indicators cleared; read back card count, per-file controls and notifications.

checkpoints.observed: After the UI had 20 attachments, the next 15-file selection was accepted; the settled UI showed all names count-21.txt through count-35.txt. None of the 15 were rejected.
The composer retained all 20 original items and added all 15 new items, for 35 total. No remaining-10 hint, alert, status message, or toast was visible.

attempts.observed_result: The 20+15 workflow resulted in 35 attachments, with no rejection or remaining-capacity hint. This is a directly observed difference from the stated 30-item rule.
attempts.notes: Only harmless, tiny round-owned files were attached to an unsent draft. No message was sent. Pending bilateral review; do not generalize beyond this client/session.
